query: What does a green-down arrow on lane use signs indicate to motorists in the tunnels?
reference_answer: It indicates that a motorist can drive on ahead.
context:
[Document 1]
Merging arrows indicate that two traffic lanes are merging into one traffic lane and give motorists advance warning of this situation.

[Document 2]
Warning signs can indicate slippery roads, gated and ungated level crossings, uneven roads, road humps, steep upward and downward slopes, roads leading to quays, river banks, or seas.

[Document 3]
Drivers must insert the cash card in advance for ERP payments when driving in tunnels.

[Document 4]
Mandatory signs are compulsory signs.

[Document 5]
It warns drivers that the road ahead will narrow on one side, requiring caution and potential adjustments in lane position.
answer: A green-down arrow on lane use signs in tunnels indicates the road ahead will narrow on one side, requiring caution and potential lane adjustments. [Document 5]
